subject: psychology

moments.title: The Behaviour of Organisms
moments.body: Skinner formalises operant conditioning, introducing the operant chamber and rate of response as the dependent variable.
moments.takeaway: A standardised apparatus lets a research programme accumulate comparable data.

moments.title: Verbal Behaviour
moments.body: Skinner extends operant principles to language. Chomsky's 1959 review will demolish the account.
moments.takeaway: Programmes overreach into adjacent territory at their own risk.

moments.title: Beyond Freedom and Dignity
moments.body: Skinner's popular book argues autonomous selfhood obstructs effective behaviour design. Time magazine cover and intense backlash.
moments.takeaway: Behaviourism's philosophical implications became as controversial as its methods.

now.title: Operant conditioning today
now.body: Behaviour analysis dominates evidence-based autism intervention. Reinforcement schedules underlie social media and game design.
now.open_questions: What ethical limits should constrain reinforcement-based design in apps for children?

reflection: Skinner thought he was building a science of behaviour; his readers focused on the philosophy.
